name: System Business Information
definition: Details about business information related to a system.

Subject.name: Subject
Subject.definition: Subject line of an item of general business information, summarizing the topic and intended destination of the information.

SubjectDetails.name: Subject Details
SubjectDetails.definition: General business information, in unstructured form.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification of a general business information system, as assigned by the system transaction administrator.

Reference.name: Reference
Reference.definition: Unique and unambiguous reference assigned to a general business information system.

Qualifier.name: Qualifier
Qualifier.definition: Further information about the criticality or importance of a general business information system.

System.name: System
System.definition: System for which business information is generated.
